name: pool-quote
description: Swimming pool quotation application — create, price, PDF and share quotes.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @pool-quote/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate -- --name init && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pool-quote/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pool-quote/shared" "npm run dev -w @pool-quote/server" "npm run dev -w @pool-quote/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pool-quote/shared && npm run build -w @pool-quote/server && npm run build -w @pool-quote/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pool-quote/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pool-quote/server && npm run typecheck -w @pool-quote/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pool-quote/shared && npm run test -w @pool-quote/shared && npm run test -w @pool-quote/server
